description: Get a single content entry by UUID. Response includes uuid, locale, published_at, and a `fields` object (custom field values — not a nested `data` key). Relation fields appear as nested entry objects (one-to-one) or arrays of entries (one-to-many), not as bare UUIDs.

exclude.description: Comma-separated field names to exclude from `fields` (e.g. 'body,excerpt')

locale.description: Locale code for the entry to load

timestamps.description: If true, include created_at and updated_at on the entry

translation_locale.description: If set, return the linked translation in this locale instead of the entry identified by uuid (same translation group).

name: get_entry
title: Get Entry
